label: Jason "The Goat" Doods
how: Won a Trio Ladder Match against Soniq and Inferno at THE PWF REBIRTH to become the new and undisputed PWF World Champion.
note: The reign's own end is not captured: by 24 March 2001 Michael Pellington is announcing a fresh tournament to crown a new World Champion, and Antonio Gambino is demanding the belt back as the pre-hibernation champion. No document in this capture records how or when Doods lost it.

title: pwf-powersite-world
label: Crusader Chrome
how: Won a Double Jeopardy Ladder Match for the World and US Titles at War Games, with interference from Bloodbath and Havok — the assist that formed the OutKasts stable, per the group's own bio card.
note: The prior holder is not named in the surviving text (see this title's own epitaph for the gap between Doods's October 2000 win and this reign).

title: pwf-powersite-us
label: Rye Hazwaki
how: Won the US Title in the same Double Jeopardy Ladder Match that crowned Crusader Chrome World Champion at War Games, with interference from Havok — the assist that formed the OutKasts stable, per the group's own bio card.
note: The prior holder is not named in the surviving text.
